To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the aquatic macrophyte diversity in the rivers of the upper reaches of Taihu Lake watershed is very low,with the submersed aquatic macrophytes being seriously threatened.
aquatic environmental factors such like N and P in water and in sediments have significant influences on the distribution of aquatic macrophytes in the upper reaches waters of Taihu Lake.
aquatic environmental factors, especially nutrient content, have exerted influences on distribution pattern of aquatic macrophytes in the upper reaches waters of the Taihu lake watershed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the distribution pattern of aquatic macrophytes,which is influenced by water quality and sediment quality in the rivers and the Lake.
the aquatic environmental conditions in the upper reaches,which are closely related to the aquatic macrophyte community structure,composition and distribution pattern.
the distribution pattern of aquatic plants in Taihu Lake watershed,and its relationship to the aquatic environmental factors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the aquatic environmental quality of the upper reaches of Taihu Lake watershed is poor,and the distribution of aquatic plants is influenced by aquatic environmental factors.
the aquatic plants in the upper reaches are in a state of decline and degradation,and their diversity is on decrease.
the water quality in the Taihu watershed is poor and the aquatic plants are on decrease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the aquatic environment of the upper reaches of Taihu Lake is on the level between Class IV and Class III,which is a typical hyper-eutrophication.
the aquatic plants are seriously affected by the hyper-eutrophication of the waters in the upper reaches.

,for the aquatic environment in the upper reaches,Taihu Lake watershed is in a state of serious eutrophication,and the aquatic plants have shown a tendency of decline,which is closely associated with water environmental factors.
The main takeaway from our work is that

,as the aquatic environment in the upper reaches has been seriously deteriorated,therefore,there is an urgent need for the protection of the water quality in the watershed,and the ecological environment of the lake should be restored.
the upper reaches of Taihu Lake watershed are in urgent need of ecological restoration.
the upper reaches of Taihu Lake watershed is a eutrophication area,which has a serious effect on the aquatic macrophyte community,especially the submersed macrophoyte.
